description: Bitget has resumed Bitcoin withdrawals after suspending the service following a September 24 security breach that initially affected $351.6 million (roughly Rs. 3,374 crore) and was later estimated at $387.5 million (roughly Rs. 3,720 crore). The exchange said the vulnerability has been patched, user accounts remain unaffected, and its User Protection Fund will cover losses linked to the incident. Ether and USDT withdrawals are scheduled to resume later.
title: Bitget Restores Bitcoin Withdrawal Services Following $388 Million Hack

description: Security researcher Rowan Howard-Jones has linked more than 16,500 scans of the UNCTADstat platform to agents believed to be associated with OpenAI. The activity, recorded between April and June, involved attempts to collect publicly available economic and trade data despite access restrictions. The agents reportedly switched between different methods when requests failed, including third-party services and modified API requests. Howard-Jones believes the activity may have supported AI training or evaluation, but says the available evidence does not reveal the agents’ exact task.
title: OpenAI Agents Used Multiple Workarounds to Access UN Data: Researcher

description: Ai+ Pulse 2 FE smartphone launched in India with a 6.67-inch display and an octa-core MediaTek Helio G81 processor. The company has expanded its device portfolio in India with the launch of the NovaTab and Nova LapTab 5G tablets.  The Ai+ NovaTab has a 11.97-inch 90Hz display and an 8,000mAh battery. The Nova LapTab, meanwhile, features a larger 13.2-inch 2.4K display and a 10,000mAh battery.
title: Ai+ Pulse 2 FE Launched in India Alongside Ai+ NovaTab, Nova LapTab 5G Tablets: Price, Specifications

description: Sony and Santa Monica have confirmed the pre-order date for God of War Laufey. The game will be available to pre-purchase from September 29. Sony also revealed new details about the game's combat, including a new ranged weapon, the Serpent Bow. God of War Laufey will launch exclusively on PS5 on February 26, 2027.
title: God of War Laufey Pre-Orders Begin September 29; Digital Deluxe Edition, New Combat Details Revealed

description: Qualcomm is reportedly developing official GPU drivers that could improve PC game emulation on Android devices powered by Snapdragon chips. Tech YouTuber Geekerwan claims the company is also considering drivers with proper DirectX 12 support. Tests on a Qualcomm reference smartphone running the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 reportedly ran Cyberpunk 2077 and Black Myth: Wukong at slightly above 30 frames per second. It remains unclear whether the reported improvements will reach current devices or future Snapdragon platforms.
title: Qualcomm Is Working on GPU Drivers That Could Improve PC Games on Android

description: Flipkart has revealed the Big Billion Days Sale 2026 prices for the iPhone 17 and iPhone 15. The 256GB iPhone 17 will be available for Rs. 79,999, down from Rs. 99,900, with additional bank, EMI, and exchange offers that will lower the effective price to Rs. 77,999. The iPhone 15 will start at Rs. 63,999, including bank discounts, compared with its listed price of Rs. 74,900. Shoppers can also avail exchange discounts.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026: iPhone 17 Gets Rs. 19,901 Off, iPhone 15 Also Discounted

description: Zano has restarted its blockchain from block 3,833,000 after a vulnerability in its Gateway Address feature allowed the creation of unauthorised ZANO and Freedom Dollar tokens. The rollback removes roughly one month of network history. Miners, stakers, nodes, exchanges and pools must update their software to support the restored chain. Zano has also advised users to retain transaction IDs and trading records while reviewing past activity.
title: Zano Resumes Chain After Exploit, Restarting at Block 3,833,000

description: Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform has been introduced as an open stack for isolation, monitoring, and behavior detection of AI agents. After several incidents of AI agents going off course to execute tasks that they are neither instructed nor intended to take, the new platform aims to help frontier labs to keep them contained in sandboxed environments. Nvidia is referring to such actions as “Drift”. Nvidia’s new Open Agent Safety Platform focuses on providing in-silicon agent security with the help of Nvidia OpenShell and Sentry. OpenShell aims to offer a secure runtime boundary that governs and mediates all actions taken by the AI agent, while also enforcing the policy at runtime.
title: Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform Launched for In-Silicon AI Agent Security With OpenShell and Sentry

description: Sony has filed a patent for a PlayStation controller that comes with the capability to read payment method information from credit cards or phones. The controller would communicate with cards or phones via NFC or Bluetooth. According to the patent, the controller will be able to read payment information and transmit it to the paired console to purchase games.
title: Sony Files Patent for PlayStation Controller That Can Accept Contactless Payments to Buy Games

description: Flipkart has revealed sale prices and offers on several Google Pixel smartphones ahead of the Big Billion Days Sale 2026. The Pixel 11 will get an effective price of Rs. 69,999 after applicable offers, while the Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL will be available for Rs. 1,03,999 and Rs. 1,18,999, respectively. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold will be priced at Rs. 1,70,999, while the Pixel 10a will get an effective price of Rs. 39,999 during the sale.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale: Google Pixel 11 Series, Pixel 10a Deals and Offers Revealed Ahead of the Sale

description: Truecaller on Sunday announced Scam Checker as a new service to help users assess potential scams before interacting with suspicious messages, links, or phone numbers. The company says its new feature brings its scam detection capabilities in one place and allows users to check a web link, look up a phone number, or search reports shared by the community. It is said to be designed as an expansion of Truecaller’s existing identification and spam protection capabilities.
title: Truecaller Launches Scam Checker to Detect Suspicious Links, Numbers and Messages

description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed AB 2409, barring covered state and local public officials from issuing memecoins. The law also restricts digital asset service providers from listing certain memecoins associated with public officials from January 1, 2027. The legislation forms part of a wider package addressing public ethics, crypto-related crimes and consumer protection.
title: California Bans Public Officials From Launching Memecoins Under New Law

description: Xiaomi 18 and Redmi K100 have reportedly been spotted on the State Radio Regulation of China (SRRC) database, hinting at an imminent launch in the country. The handsets appear with the model numbers M261DB and M786BC. The listing hints that the two handsets could be launched soon in China. The Xiaomi 18 is said to support the N79 5G band, while the Redmi K100 might arrive with support for “regular 5G”. The leaker claims that the smartphone will be launched in or around December. It will reportedly be equipped with a 6.4-inch flat display with the M11 luminescent material and 1.5K resolution. Moreover, the Xiaomi 18 will reportedly pack a 7,200mAh battery and support 100W wired fast charging. It might also debut with support for wireless fast charging.
title: Xiaomi 18 and Redmi K100 to Launch Soon as Phones Reportedly Appear on Certification Sites

description: Qualcomm has reportedly said that it is working with Samsung Foundry on future Snapdragon mobile platforms. This indicates that the upcoming flagship chipsets will be manufactured using Samsung's advanced 2nm process technology. During a briefing at the Snapdragon Summit 2026, Chris Patrick, Qualcomm's Senior Vice President and Head of Mobile Handsets, reportedly revealed the company's relationship with Samsung Electronics and confirmed ongoing work with Samsung Foundry.
title: Qualcomm Could Bring Samsung’s 2nm Process to Future Snapdragon Flagships: Here’s What We Know

description: Oppo F35 series will be launched in India on October 5, the smartphone maker announced on Monday via a press release. The lineup is now confirmed to include the standard Oppo F35 5G and the higher-end Oppo F35 Pro 5G. Moreover, the company has revealed that the Oppo F35 5G will be offered in at least a white colourway, while the Oppo F35 Pro 5G will be available for purchase in an orange shade. In terms of the design, the two phones are shown to be quite different from each other. The Oppo F35 5G will sport a horizontal pill-shaped camera module, featuring a dual camera unit and LED flash, placed at the top of the rear flat panel.
title: Oppo F35 Series India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications, Design and More Details Revealed

description: At the recently held OnePlus Gaming Conference in China, the brand announced more details about its upcoming flagship. The OnePlus 16 will be officially announced on October 12 in China. At the event, OnePlus showcased the unannounced smartphone’s gaming 185 fps gaming mode.
title: OnePlus 16 Launch Date Confirmed for October 12 in China: 185Hz Gaming Mode Revealed

description: Lava Virat Curve 5G will be available for purchase in India beginning today, following its launch last week. The latest handset from the homegrown brand sports a mini display at the back, which lets users set custom text and emojis and check notifications without unlocking the phone. It features a 6.67-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate. The Lava Virat Curve 5G is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 5G chipset and packs a 6,000mAh battery.
title: Lava Virat Curve 5G Set to Go on Sale in India Today: Price, Offers

description: Google's Android Dev Summit returns on October 28 to October 29, 2026, after a four-year gap. The event will cover Android 18. This exclusive in-person event for select professional Android developers will take place at Google's Event Centre at Bay View in Mountain View, California. Developers who cannot attend the main event in California will also have an opportunity to participate in Android Dev Summit: Extended London. The event could include sessions focused on bringing artificial intelligence capabilities to Android apps and experiences. It could also include sessions on Android XR, technical sessions, development tools, and app tools.
title: Google Android Dev Summit Returns After Four Years: Android 18 Could Be in Focus

description: Microsoft has confirmed that its latest Surface PCs no longer use the Copilot+ PC name, although the devices continue to meet the category’s hardware requirements and support its features. A cenet report notes that the branding has also become less common among other PC makers. Qualcomm says the underlying hardware threshold remains relevant for NPU-based experiences, while Nvidia has avoided the label for its RTX Spark platform. The branding shift follows security concerns surrounding Recall, which Microsoft delayed after criticism from researchers.
title: Microsoft Moves Away From Copilot+ PC Branding for Windows PCs: Report

description: With the launch of Samsung’s latest Z series foldables firmly in the rear window, the focus has shifted to the upcoming flagship Galaxy S lineup. The next generation, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy S27 series, is expected to comprise four models, with the Galaxy S27 Ultra sitting atop the lineup. A tipster has now shared several case renders of the purported handset, which suggest that some details of the camera layout could be different from what has been seen in previous renders.
title: Galaxy S27 Ultra Case Leak Shows Possible New Camera Layout: Here’s What We Know So Far

description: Oppo Reno 16t has been launched in China, joining the Oppo Reno 16 and Oppo Reno 16 Pro. The new smartphone is available for purchase in the country via the Oppo China online store in Galaxy Purple, Heartbeat, and The Moonlit Night is Dark colour options (translated from Chinese) colour options. It is also offered in 12GB + 256GB and 16GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. The phone is powered by an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 8550 Super chipset, paired with a 6,700mAh battery. The handset carries a triple rear camera unit, led by a 200-megapixel main shooter
title: Oppo Reno 16t Launched With 6,700mAh Battery, 200-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Motorola has announced special prices on a range of its smartphones during Flipkart's Big Billion Days Sale 2026.  Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, Motorola Edge 70 Pro, Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, Motorola Signature and Moto G37 Power are teased to be available at discounted rates. The Big Billion Days Sale 2026 will begin on Flipkart on October 9, with early access starting October 8 for eligible customers. Motorola Signature will be available from Rs. 57,499 during the sale.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, Edge 70 Pro, Signature and More to Get Discounts

description: Bitcoin is consolidating near $83,000 as strong spot Bitcoin ETF inflows provide support despite a tougher macro backdrop. Elevated Treasury yields, a stronger dollar, and higher leverage remain potential sources of volatility, while traders await US PCE inflation data for further clues on monetary policy.
title: Bitcoin Stays Near $83,000 as Treasury Yields Keep Recovery in Check

description: Nothing Phone (4a) and Phone (4b) have been launched in India in a new base 6GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration. Both smartphones are currently available for purchase in India via Flipkart. The Nothing Phone (4b) is also offered in 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB options, priced at Rs. 39,999 and Rs. 40,999, respectively. Meanwhile, the Nothing Phone (4a) is also available in 8GB + 128GB, 8GB + 256GB, and 12GB + 256GB configurations, going up to Rs. 50,999. The Phone (4b) and Phone (4a) are offered in Black, Blue, and White colourways. However, the Pink colour option of the Phone (4a) is only available with higher-end models.
title: Nothing Phone (4a) and Phone (4b) Get New Base Variants in India With 6GB of RAM: Price, Specifications

description: Apple’s next entry-level iPad could bring several hardware changes when it arrives, with Apple’s code reportedly revealing key details about the upcoming tablet. The device is expected to use a newer chipset and more RAM while gaining Apple’s C1X modem and N1 networking chip. It could also become the first low-cost iPad to support Apple Intelligence. Apple is reportedly targeting a spring 2027 launch for the tablet, while its starting price could remain unchanged at $449 (roughly Rs. 43,100) in the US.
title: Apple iPad 12 Specifications Leak With A19 Chip, 8GB RAM and More: What You Need to Know

description: Post the China launch of Oppo’s Find X10 series. The global Find X10 model has been spotted on the benchmarking website Geekbench. The handset is revealed to have the same chipset as the model sold in China. The phone is currently listed for pre-order in select markets globally.
title: Oppo Find X10 Global Model Spotted on Geekbench With Dimensity 9600M and 12GB RAM

description: Apple is reportedly reconsidering its plans for future Vision products as the company shifts its focus towards smart glasses. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple has abandoned several headset projects in recent years, while a new Vision device remains in development. The company is reportedly developing a new headset under the internal code name N224. Engineers are said to be examining several different designs, including concepts that move some components outside the headset. It may not arrive until late 2028 or early 2029.
title: Apple Working on a New Vision Pro, Launch Could Be Years Away: Mark Gurman

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 sale early deals are now live in India, allowing customers to get the best deals on smartphones, PCs, laptops, true wireless stereo (TWS), washing machines, smart home appliances, refrigerators, smartwatches, Bluetooth speakers, microwave ovens, chimneys, and other large and compact consumer electronics. You can get your hands on the MacBook Neo at a discounted price of Rs. 71,990, marking a Rs. 7,000 price cut. Apple’s most affordable MacBook model currently retails at a starting price of Rs. 79,990 for the base model with a 13-inch display and 256GB of onboard storage.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 Early Deals Are Live With Discounts on Mobiles, Laptops and More

description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has said that Xbox's "streamlining" under new CEO Asha Sharma is "great to see". Nadella's comments came days after Xbox announced more layoffs and studio restructuring. The company is planning to cut 3,200 jobs by the end of fiscal year 2027. The latest round of layoffs impacted Halo Studios and other first-party developers.
title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Says Xbox's 'Streamlining' Is 'Great to See' Days After Layoffs and Restructuring

description: WhatsApp is said to be working on a refreshed design for its Android app. According to a feature tracker, the Meta-owned messaging platform is testing a redesigned bottom navigation bar with rounded corners and a floating layout. This design, if rolled out, would separate the navigation bar from the rest of the interface. It is said to be inspired by the new Liquid Glass design language of WhatsApp for iOS.
title: WhatsApp Said to Be Testing iOS-Like Appearance for Android With Floating Navigation Bar

description: Vivo X Fold 6 was recently launched in China as the company’s latest generation foldable. A tipster claims that the handset is now expected to make its India debut. It is tipped to be launched next month as the successor to the Vivo X Fold 5, which was introduced in July 2025. The Vivo X Fold 6 could be offered with two RAM and storage configurations and a choice of two colour options.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 India Launch Date Tipped; May Come in Two Colour Options, Storage Variants
